description: Compare live shipping rates for one parcel across every carrier available on the SIGNED-IN account (Canada Post, Purolator, UPS, FedEx and others), at the prices of that account. Returns each carrier and service with its total price, currency and estimated transit days. Requires the user to connect their account; for someone without an account use get_shipping_quote, which needs no sign-in. Prices are live and account-specific; do not cache them.

from_country.description: Origin country, ISO alpha-2. Defaults to "CA".

from_postal.description: Origin postal or ZIP code, e.g. "H2X 1Y1".

residential.description: True if delivering to a home address. Affects price on some carriers.

to_country.description: Destination country, ISO alpha-2. Defaults to "CA".

to_postal.description: Destination postal or ZIP code, e.g. "M5V 2T6".

weight_kg.description: Parcel weight in kilograms. Must be greater than 0.

name: compare_shipping_rates
title: Compare shipping rates
